shortlist.title: Attention-Aligned Reasoning for Large Language Models
shortlist.authors: Hongxiang Zhang; Yuan Tian; Tianyi Zhang
shortlist.depth: Official HTML main text, references and appendices read; v1 also consulted; formula/table evidence, not visual figure audit
shortlist.evidence: Section 2 Eq 3 and Appendix A.2 Eq 5: harmonic aggregation; Table 7 compares aggregation choices. Appendix B explicitly describes an extra masked forward for full ATAR. Appendix E uses greedy decoding and mostly NF4 quantization; base models are non-reasoning models.
shortlist.decision: Borrow aggregation alone. Retain raw maximum probabilities and original ReBalance coefficient direction, boundaries, vector and L27 suppression. Recalibrate signal quantiles/tau from old 500 trajectories; no regenerated calibration answers.
shortlist.limits: Not official ATAR/CGRS, not its full attention mechanism, not a theorem that harmonic improves compression. Table 7 geometric vs arithmetic ranking is not uniform despite prose. Do not transfer its benchmark gains. No official ATAR implementation confirmed in this search.

shortlist.title: Thinking by Subtraction: Confidence-Driven Contrastive Decoding for LLM Reasoning
shortlist.authors: Lexiang Tang; Weihao Gao; Bingchen Zhao; Lu Ma; Qiao Jin; Bang Yang; Yuexian Zou
shortlist.depth: Official HTML main text, algorithm, references and appendix read; linked ccd.py read end-to-end
shortlist.evidence: Section 2.2 uses negative mean top-k log probability, not entropy. Algorithm 1 maintains two contexts. Current ccd.py lines 178-192 runs both model contexts EVERY token, even when contrast is inactive; top_k_conf=20, window=2048, warmup=512. Threshold window excludes current score in code.
shortlist.decision: Defer complete integration: dual KV histories, extra model work and different signal; not a cheap drop-in lexical penalty.
shortlist.limits: Section 2.5 no-extra-forward wording conflicts with public implementation. Runtime cost must be measured, not inferred from paper efficiency claims. AIME Mean@8 conditions are not our MATH/GSM single-seed protocol. Mutable main code URL not pinned for execution; no code executed.
